metaDescription: Order custom pink lanyards for your next event or promotion. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround, and free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Pink lanyards offer a bold, recognizable way to display IDs and access passes at events, trade shows, or in the office. Whether you choose a vibrant neon shade for high-visibility safety or a softer tone for a breast cancer awareness campaign, pink makes a statement. Options like the 1" Knit-In Lanyard provide durability for daily use, while the Sublimated Charm Lanyard allows full-color custom branding. Perfect for marketing directors and HR managers looking to combine function with a distinct color identity.
heroAltText: Custom pink lanyards with ID badge holder and full-color imprint, displayed on a desk.
